Package com.mycompany.icmsalpha

Class CloneMethodLinker

java.lang.Object
com.mycompany.icmsalpha.CloneMethodLinker
public class CloneMethodLinker extends Object
Links clones to their containing methods across revisions. For each clone, finds the method that contains it by matching: - File path (normalized) - Clone line range [StartLine, EndLine] inside method range [start_line, end_line]
